Who I Am

About Me

I'm Muhammad Sarim, known online as SarimFX — a graphic designer and video editor from Pakistan. For the past 4+ years I've partnered with content creators, vloggers, and businesses across Pakistan and abroad, shaping their raw ideas into polished thumbnails, banners, logos, and edited videos that actually get the click.

From punchy YouTube thumbnails to full channel branding and short-form reel edits, I care about one thing: making every client's work look sharper than yesterday. Clean communication, fast turnarounds, and pixel-level attention to detail is how I work.
